About.title: Fullstack developer who likes shipping real things
About.p1: I'm Huy, a Software Engineering graduate from Can Tho University (GPA 3.55). Over 1.5+ years and four roles I've built production software — clinic websites at scale, internal dashboards, an AI-powered platform, and Odoo ERP modules.
About.p2: I care about performance, accessibility and clean component design. I'm comfortable across the stack: React and Next.js with TypeScript on the frontend, NestJS + PostgreSQL on the backend, and Python/Odoo for ERP.
About.p3: Outside of work I write study notes (you'll find some in the Docs section) and keep experimenting with new tools to ship faster without cutting corners.
